criterion: ccmorph help all shows each command once, in groups, with no line that tells the reader to run ccmorph help all.
evidence: cli/main.go usage(): `case "", "all"` renders one page — the everyday groups, then (all only) More commands and Advanced troubleshooting, then the footer; the short page is no longer printed inside it. Widened test_help_is_concise_truthful_and_read_only in tests/cli_messages_test.py asserts no 'ccmorph help all' line in the help-all page and no duplicated '  ccmorph ' row; watched red on the broken code (the line 'More commands: ccmorph help all' mid-page), green after. Hermetic run with two profiles (work, personal) shows the five groups and no self-referential line.

criterion: The line about where to start does not name a profile that exists, or does not appear when profiles exist.
evidence: The footer prints 'Start here: ccmorph add work' only when l.confNames() is empty. The same test writes state/work.conf and asserts neither --help nor help all prints 'Start here' (rc asserted 0 so the pages really rendered); the empty-state phase asserts the line is still there for a fresh install. Hermetic runs confirm: with work.conf present the line is gone from both pages; without confs it appears on both.

criterion: The lines about command details and the version appear once, at the end of the page.
evidence: The footer ends both pages once: Command details and Version are the last two lines, after every group. The test asserts count('Command details:') == 1, count('Version: ccmorph --version') == 1 and stdout ends with those two lines; watched red on the broken code (the page ended on the context-limit row), green after. Hermetic help-all run ends: 'Command details: ccmorph help <command>' then 'Version: ccmorph --version'.
